column1: # The fixes sprint of 2026-09-22, as Rowan held it by hand: the task set behind the numbers

# The fourteen closed rows carry the primary record that closed them, and their leased and
# done stamps are what the actual is measured from; the nine open rows carry the estimate
# made BEFORE the work, which is the only kind of estimate the calibration can learn from.
# NOTE ON THE LANES: Johnny's three open fixes sit in three packages with no file in common.
# Nothing in this file says they depend on each other, because they do not: the four hours
# were one person holding three tasks, which is the false serial dependency the wall
# computation names and the hand-over removes.
